overview_description.description:
ModernLoop is a platform that enables recruiting teams to automate and streamline the coordination of interviews to provide an excellent hiring experience. Coordinating interviews since 2020 has become increasingly dynamic, and ModernLoop helps recruiting teams create efficiencies in their operations and scale.

ModernLoop was founded in 2020 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

product.name: Interview Scheduling Platform
product.description: A platform that automates and manages the scheduling of candidate interviews, coordinating interviewer availability and candidate times across time zones.

product.name: Interviewer Training Management
product.description: A system to manage and track interviewer training, including shadowing and reverse-shadowing processes to ensure interviewers are prepared and qualified.

product.name: Slack Integration for Interview Coordination
product.description: An integration that automatically creates private Slack channels for interview loops, facilitating communication and information sharing among interviewers.
